titolo: NVIDIA Dory 1.0 4B model can be run locally with llama.cpp, guide released
descr: A November 2026 MarkTechPost guide shows how to compile and run NVIDIA's 4‑billion‑parameter Dory 1.0 BF16 model using llama.cpp.
paragrafi: NVIDIA made its Dory 1.0 4B language model available on Hugging Face under the repository nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B-BF16.
The tutorial walks users through building a pinned llama.cpp branch, analyzing compute costs per loop, testing memory caching, and executing paired evaluations.
The guide targets developers who want to run Dory locally, but it does not state a specific consumer machine that can hold the entire model in memory.
Dory joins other highly ranked free chat models such as Kimi K3 Max and GLM‑5.3 Max, expanding options for offline AI use.
perche: For users seeking alternatives to paid offerings, Dory adds another high‑quality, open‑access model that can be experimented with on compatible hardware.
